commit_message:
wait_and_reap: kill what a process started however it ends; start_time (#24)

* wait_and_reap: kill what a process started however it ends; start_time

kill_process_tree reads the tree below a live process, so a process that exits on
its own (a crash, or between a timeout and the kill) leaves its re-parented
workers running. wait_and_reap watches the tree while waiting and, after any
exit, kills the descendants it saw that are still the same processes (start
time), plus orphans in the process's own group. First customer: arioso compare
(thorwhalen/arioso#67).

* wait_and_reap: review fixes

Reap on any exception (Ctrl-C does not reach a child in its own session); bounded
wait after the kill; (pid, start time) pairs read every pass; no watch thread on
Windows; interval validated; tests for the interrupted wait and for a worker in
the caller's own group; the timeout test waits for its pidfile first.
